filled_excerpt: Applied to a Jatibarang-anchored case study with 177 geological realizations spanning porosity 0.17 to 0.22 and matrix permeability 10.0 to 114.0 mD, the surrogate achieves one-step pressure R2 of 0.9999, gas plume IoU of 0.9756, and cumulative production error below 1.84%, with end-of-sequence CO2 mass error of 3.35%. The framework screens 3240 integrated scenarios in 0.6351 minutes versus 2.38 weeks for equivalent compositional coverage. Under current carbon pricing the optimal plan yields NPV of $-8.30 million; under JCM bilateral pricing NPV rises to $-2.62 million and well selection shifts, with 18 of 20 candidates changing priority. The break-even carbon price is $54.52 per tonne. These results demonstrate that surrogate-enabled integrated screening materially improves CO2 HnP-CCUS planning and that Indonesian carbon pricing, even at nascent levels, alters which development strategies are optimal.
